title: Rewiring Legal Research for an AI-Native Future - Webinar recording
summary: A large part of legal work begins with research: establishing what the law is and whether it still applies. It is also the step where AI has proved hardest to trust. Legora hosted a webinar on what it takes to build legal research natively for AI.
body_markdown:
**What the webinar covers:**


-


A new model for legal research once the law becomes fully navigable, and why bigger or better AI models alone won’t get us there


-


How to distinguish between AI that truly understands the law from AI that merely pattern-matches text, and why this difference means everything for legal research


-


How value shifts once rigorous research becomes abundant, and why human judgement will matter more, not less


Audience Q&A was captured after the presentation.


Learn more about Legora's legal research capabilities[here](https://legora.com/product/legal-research) .
